programme.title: Report
programme.desc: Tedenska predstavitev vsebin iz lokalnega okolja. Voditeljica Špela Pokeržnik gosti športnike, glasbenike, politike in vodje društev. Usodne volitve – kaj vmesne volitve v ZDA pomenijo za Avstrijo? Svet 3. novembra z napetostjo zre v ZDA. Na polovici drugega mandata Donalda Trumpa so na sporedu vmesne volitve – znova se voli predstavniški dom in del senata. Kakšne posledice – politične, gospodarske in družbene – gre pričakovati? Podoba ZDA se je v Avstriji v zadnjem času spremenila – od "najljubše okupacijske sile", ki nam je prinesla mir, svoboden tisk, pakete pomoči Care, kavbojke in demokracijo, do vse bolj nepredvidljivega partnerja. Ulla Kramar-Schmid in Sabina Riedl raziskujeta, kako so se spremenili odnosi Avstrije z ZDA in kakšno stališče ima danes avstrijska politika do Donalda Trumpa. Živčnost pred deželnimi volitvami. V zveznih deželah stranke ÖVP vlada strah. Štajersko so že izgubili proti svobodnjakom, v Zgornji Avstriji in na Tirolskem pa je FPÖ v anketah že izenačena z Ljudsko stranko. S tem narašča živčnost pred deželnimi volitvami, predvolilni boji pa so se že začeli. Krivca za slabe rezultate so deželne organizacije ÖVP hitro našle: lastno zvezno stranko in delo v zvezni vladi. In tako se že začenja distanciranje, zbadanje in pošiljanje nasvetov proti zvezni ravni. Deželni glavarji ÖVP vse glasneje zahtevajo več in hitrejše reforme od zvezne vlade. Tirolska ÖVP gre zdaj celo korak dlje in želi z lastnim članstvom na Tirolskem preprečiti, da bi člani morali hkrati postati člani zvezne ÖVP. Kaj se dogaja v zveznih deželah? Kako daleč gredo poskusi distanciranja od nepriljubljene trojne koalicije na zvezni ravni? In ali se po SPÖ zdaj tudi ÖVP bliža razpravi o vodstvu stranke? Laura Franz in Patrick Gruska se podajata po sledeh dogajanja. V intervjuju: deželni glavar Zgornje Avstrije Thomas Stelzer, ÖVP. Nov zakon – podobne težave. Že en mesec električni skiroji, ki so še posebej priljubljeni med dostavljavci hrane, ne smejo več voziti po kolesarskih stezah. To naj bi po zagotovilih zakonodajalca izboljšalo prometno varnost. Toda prva ocena je mešana. Dostavljavci se zdaj ne vozijo več z električnimi skiroji, ampak z električnimi kolesi. Drago kupljenimi ali najetimi, a vsaj nekoliko počasnejšimi. Na kolesarskih stezah torej ostaja tesno, prekarni delovni pogoji dostavljavcev pa so se še dodatno zaostrili. Poročilo Barbare Krivanek in Martina Puscha.

programme.title: Playing Lessons From the Pros: Corey Conners
programme.desc: Playing Lessons From the Pros (Sports). Imagine playing a casual round of golf with a legendary player such as Jack Nicklaus, Arnold Palmer, Nick Faldo, Ray Floyd, Colin Montgomerie, Juli Inkster and Laura Davies? Those are just a few of the former greats and current stars of the PGA and LPGA tours who have taken viewers inside the ropes as they make their way around a course, discussing such things as shot setup, club selection, strategy and other helpful hints and tips. It's a priceless lesson, a chance to dissect a pro's thought process as he or she executes all manner of shots

programme.title: Playing Lessons From the Pros: Mina Harigae
programme.desc: Playing Lessons From the Pros (Sports). Imagine playing a casual round of golf with a legendary player such as Jack Nicklaus, Arnold Palmer, Nick Faldo, Ray Floyd, Colin Montgomerie, Juli Inkster and Laura Davies? Those are just a few of the former greats and current stars of the PGA and LPGA tours who have taken viewers inside the ropes as they make their way around a course, discussing such things as shot setup, club selection, strategy and other helpful hints and tips. It's a priceless lesson, a chance to dissect a pro's thought process as he or she executes all manner of shots

programme.title: Cyclisme : Milan-San Remo
programme.desc: Qui succèdera au palmarès de Milan-San Remo à Mathieu van der Poel, vainqueur, l'an dernier au sprint, devant Filippo Ganna et Tadej Pogacar ? Pour la 117e édition de la "Primavera", le parcours a été rehaussé à 298 km, mais il proposera un scénario classique, avec la Cipressa et le Poggio comme juges de paix du premier Monument de la saison. La course se conclura, comme le veut la coutume, sur la Via Roma à San Remo.

programme.title: Tadej Pogacar : Anatomy of a Goat
programme.desc: "Tadej Pogacar : Anatomy of a Goat" décrypte la domination du champion cycliste slovène. Ce documentaire analyse ses capacités physiques hors norme (VO2 Max record) et sa polyvalence unique, capable de briller sur les pavés des classiques comme en haute montagne. Le film montre comment ce coureur réécrit l'histoire pour s'imposer comme le véritable GOAT du cyclisme moderne.

programme.title: Sölden | Slalom Géant (H) - 2e manche
programme.desc: Coup d'envoi de la coupe du monde à Sölden, en Autriche. En slalom géant, le favori était le Suisse Marco Odermatt, tenant du gros globe de cristal et maître de la discipline. Mais il devait compter sur la présence de son compatriote Loïc Meillard et du Brésilien Lucas Pinheiro Braathen. A suivre également le Français Léo Anguenot.

programme.desc: Après Ding Junhui en 2024 et Wu Yize en 2025, un joueur chinois va-t-il encore s'imposer à Nankin, à l'occasion de cette 12e édition du Championnat international ? Le nouveau numéro un mondial, Zhao Xintong, se présentait comme le grand favori du tournoi, cette année.

programme.title: Sambo : Championnat du monde
programme.desc: Découvrez des épreuves du Championnat du monde de Sambo, un art martial apparu en URSS dans les années 1930, fruit d'un mélange de judo, de boxe et de lutte. La première édition a eu lieu en 1973, et elle regroupe à chaque édition les athlètes de 11 pays. A noter que les femmes n'ont participé qu'à une seule édition en 1983. La Russie et l'URSS sont les seules vainqueurs de l'épreuve, excepté en 1997 où la Géorgie l'a remporté à domicile.

L'année a été marquée par la domination sans partage de certains leaders, des duels intenses sur les routes de la Vuelta et du Tour, et de grands moments d'émotions sur les Classiques et les Mondiaux. Côté individualités, on retiendra la belle saison de Tadej Pogacar, Remco Evenepoel, Paul Seixas, Wout van Aert ou encore Paul Magnier.

programme.title: Snooker : Championnat International

programme.title: 30 for 30: Pony Excess
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.desc: Découvrez des épreuves du Championnat du monde de Sambo, un art martial apparu en URSS dans les années 1930, fruit d'un mélange de judo, de boxe et de lutte. La première édition a eu lieu en 1973, et elle regroupe à chaque édition les athlètes de 11 pays. A noter que les femmes n'ont participé qu'à une seule édition en 1983. programme.title: Sambo : Championnat du monde
programme.desc: Découvrez des épreuves du Championnat du monde de Sambo, un art martial apparu en URSS dans les années 1930, fruit d'un mélange de judo, de boxe et de lutte. La première édition a eu lieu en 1973, et elle regroupe à chaque édition les athlètes de 11 pays. A noter que les femmes n'ont participé qu'à une seule édition en 1983. programme.desc: NFL Fantasy Live (Sports). Millions of NFL fans live in a fantasy world where survival depends on successfully navigating the twists and turns of a grueling season. After all, relying on a second-string quarterback or an untested wide receiver to come up big is usually foolhardy. Avoiding such predicaments takes plenty of preparation, and that's where «NFL Fantasy Live» comes into play. Host Marcas Grant provides the advice and analysis fantasy fans need to make winning lineup decisions. And being armed with the latest player updates, stats and trends goes a long way toward turning fantasies into championships

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.desc: Sunday NFL Countdown (Sports). This Sunday pregame staple debuted in 1985 and soon became a signature ESPN series. Host Mike Greenberg introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players, coaches and executives including Tedy Bruschi, Randy Moss, Alex Smith, and Rex Ryan. Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Sunday NFL Countdown
programme.desc: Sunday NFL Countdown (Sports). This Sunday pregame staple debuted in 1985 and soon became a signature ESPN series. Host Mike Greenberg introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players, coaches and executives including Tedy Bruschi, Randy Moss, Alex Smith, and Rex Ryan. Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

programme.title: 30 for 30: Pony Excess
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Los Angeles vs. New York. WTGL
programme.desc: Disfrute de la versión femenina de la liga, creada en colaboración directa con la LPGA. Mantiene exactamente el mismo formato de entretenimiento tecnológico de corta duración, el uso de micrófonos abiertos en las jugadoras y análisis estadísticos en tiempo real. Su objetivo es conectar con nuevas audiencias y dar una plataforma masiva y moderna a las estrellas del golf femenino mundial. Gaby López es la representante de México en la temporada inaugural de la WTGL, fue confirmada oficialmente como parte del equipo Los Angeles Golf Club (LAGC).

David Pollack and others contribute reports, interviews and features

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

Host Mike Greenberg introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players, coaches and executives including Tedy Bruschi, Randy Moss, Alex Smith, and Rex Ryan. Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio

programme.desc: Sunday NFL Countdown (Sports). This Sunday pregame staple debuted in 1985 and soon became a signature ESPN series. Host Mike Greenberg introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players, coaches and executives including Tedy Bruschi, Randy Moss, Alex Smith, and Rex Ryan. Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

programme.title: Playing Lessons From the Pros: Corey Conners
programme.desc: Playing Lessons From the Pros (Sports). Imagine playing a casual round of golf with a legendary player such as Jack Nicklaus, Arnold Palmer, Nick Faldo, Ray Floyd, Colin Montgomerie, Juli Inkster and Laura Davies? Those are just a few of the former greats and current stars of the PGA and LPGA tours who have taken viewers inside the ropes as they make their way around a course, discussing such things as shot setup, club selection, strategy and other helpful hints and tips. It's a priceless lesson, a chance to dissect a pro's thought process as he or she executes all manner of shots

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Sunday NFL Countdown
programme.desc: Sunday NFL Countdown (Sports). This Sunday pregame staple debuted in 1985 and soon became a signature ESPN series. Host Mike Greenberg introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players, coaches and executives including Tedy Bruschi, Randy Moss, Alex Smith, and Rex Ryan. Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio
